notes: Standings, grades, averages, CR points and national points are the WRA grading guide report's; titles and WRCh points are the Registrar's Whippet Point Records, which WRA's help sheet names as the record.
The report lists each dog's last three adult meets as scores and completion codes (C completed; SCR, PSCR, DNF, DQ incomplete), newest first, with no dates; last_raced is therefore unknown.

avg is recomputed per rule 5.2 (the mean of the completed meets, else of the incomplete ones, else 0); avg_matches flags the Registrar's figure where it differs, and the published figure is the one shown.
Active means WRA's own active list. Test records and duplicate records in WRA's database are dropped and counted.
